description: For one AlphaCitation ruling identifier (ACPREC-YYYY-NNNN): what was decided about an evidence conflict, why, on which records, its status (settled, unresolved or superseded), with the current governing record for its medicine, market and date. A ruling is not evidence and decides no claim today; the current record does. Not for dosing, prices, shortages or news.

date.description: Optional: the date for the current record, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

id.description: The ruling identifier, for example ACPREC-2026-0001.

name: lookup_precedent_ruling
title: A numbered AlphaCitation ruling on an evidence conflict
